body_html:
#smallpoems

Carion feast
  of truth

unsparing beasts
  tearing into sinew
of what we we knew

beaks sink into
precarious cascades
  of falibility
swallowing
  falling veracity
Ravaging our
capacity to
awaken the foresaken
as
Barbarian hordes
of ruthless
  authoritarian
   Lords
have made false
claim
to maim and
stack
  carcassess
of facts as
talons
rip into
victims
in nefarious plots
of various rot

back claw
wrapping around
arteries
 empyting
armories
in ruthless attack
of toothless flack
in Iradescent folds of
Black
Packs of birds
  peck at
Bones of our
shared reality
